name: @agiler/ui
rules: Compose screens only from components declared here; never write raw CSS, hex colours or inline styles.
Use the tokens in tokens.css (or a per-order theme.json override) for every visual value.
Pin an exact @agiler/ui version per order; structure is identical everywhere, brand comes from theme tokens.
Forms must be labelled; icon-only controls must carry an aria-label.

components.name: Alert
components.summary: Inline message with an icon, optional title and dismiss action.
a11y: warning/danger use role="alert"; info/success use role="status".
The dismiss action is an aria-labelled IconButton.
components.snippet: <Alert variant="warning" title="Over budget">The quote exceeds the budget.</Alert>

components.name: AppShell
components.summary: Application shell: sidebar + topbar + main grid areas (sidebar collapses below lg).
a11y: main landmark for the content area
sidebar collapses below lg — expose it as a Drawer

components.name: AuthScreen
components.summary: The standard auth screen: passwordless (one-time code) and password sign-in in one screen, plus password reset.

props.name: onResetPassword
props.type: (email: string, code: string, newPassword: string) => void | Promise<void>

a11y: one <h1> per screen (via AuthShell)
the sign-in method is a tablist (role=tab/tabpanel) with arrow-key navigation
errors are announced via role=alert

components.name: AuthShell
components.summary: Centered card shell for auth screens — one <h1>, with brand and footer slots and no app chrome.
a11y: renders the screen's single <h1>
main landmark for the card
components.snippet: <AuthShell title="Sign in" subtitle="Use a one-time code or your password.">{form}</AuthShell>

components.name: AuthTabs
components.summary: Accessible tablist for switching sign-in method (passwordless vs password). Controlled.
a11y: role=tablist/tab/tabpanel with aria-selected, aria-controls and arrow-key navigation
components.snippet: <AuthTabs value={tab} onChange={setTab} tabs={[{ id: 'otp', label: 'One-time code', content: … }]} />

components.name: Badge
components.summary: Compact status/label chip with semantic variants.
a11y: Presentational; pair with text that carries the meaning.

components.name: Breadcrumbs
components.summary: Hierarchical location trail; router-agnostic via linkComponent.
a11y: nav[aria-label="Breadcrumb"]; the last crumb carries aria-current="page".

components.name: Button
components.summary: Primary action control with variants, sizes, loading state and icon slots.
a11y: Renders a native <button>.
Sets aria-busy while loading and disables the control.

components.name: Card
components.summary: Surface container with optional header/footer and padding scale.
a11y: Use `as` to keep landmarks/headings semantic (e.g. as="article", as="section").

components.name: Checkbox
components.summary: Labelled checkbox with error and helper text.
a11y: Label wraps the input; error sets aria-invalid and is linked via aria-describedby.
components.snippet: <Checkbox label="Run with AI agents" checked={on} onChange={…} />

components.name: DataTable
components.summary: Table with sorting, search, paging, CSV export, row actions and an empty state.
a11y: Provide `caption` for screen readers.
Shows a Skeleton while loading and a labelled empty state when there are no rows.
components.snippet: <DataTable columns={columns} data={rows} getRowId={(r) => r.id} caption="Accounts" searchable pageSize={10} />

components.name: DatePicker
components.summary: Labelled date/time input (date, datetime-local, time or month).
a11y: Labelled; error linked via aria-describedby.

components.name: Drawer
components.summary: Edge-anchored panel for detail views and mobile navigation.
a11y: Portalled dialog with a focus trap, Esc-to-close and background scroll lock.

components.name: EmptyState
components.summary: Consistent empty state (icon, title, description, action).
a11y: text-first; decorative icon is aria-hidden
components.snippet: <EmptyState title="No accounts yet" description="Create your first account." action={<Button>New</Button>} />

components.name: FieldLabel
components.summary: Form label primitive (used by every field component).
a11y: Renders <label htmlFor>; marks required fields.

components.name: FieldMessage
components.summary: Error / helper text primitive wired to field a11y ids.
a11y: Rendered with the ids referenced by aria-describedby.

components.name: FileUpload
components.summary: Drag-and-drop / browse file input with size guard.
a11y: Labelled; exposes the browse action as a Button.

components.name: Grid
components.summary: Responsive content grid — auto-fit by min item width, or fixed columns.
a11y: layout only — keep DOM order equal to reading order

components.name: IconButton
components.summary: Square icon-only button — an accessible name is required by the type.
a11y: `aria-label` is a required prop so icon-only controls are always announced.

components.name: Input
components.summary: Labelled text input with optional addons, error and helper text.
a11y: label + aria-describedby (error/helper) + aria-invalid on error.

components.name: Loader
components.summary: Centered loading state with a label; can fill the viewport.
a11y: Wraps Spinner, which announces its label via role="status".

components.name: Modal
components.summary: Centered dialog with overlay, focus trap and footer slot.
a11y: Portalled dialog with a focus trap, Esc-to-close and background scroll lock.
Pass `ariaLabel` when there is no visible title.
components.snippet: <Modal isOpen={open} onClose={close} title="Place an order" footer={<Button>Save</Button>}>…</Modal>

components.name: MultiSelect
components.summary: Multi-value dropdown that renders selected values as chips.
a11y: Labelled combobox; collapses extra chips into a “+N more” indicator.

components.name: OtpSignIn
components.summary: Passwordless sign-in: email → one-time code, with resend and dev-echo support.
a11y: labelled fields; the code input uses autocomplete="one-time-code"

components.name: PageHeader
components.summary: Page title block owning the single <h1> of a screen, with description and actions.
a11y: renders the single <h1> for the screen

components.name: Pagination
components.summary: Page navigation with optional page-size selector.
a11y: Buttons carry accessible names; state is exposed via aria-current on the page.

components.name: Panel
components.summary: Region container (bordered surface) used to compose layout regions.
a11y: use `title` for a named region heading

components.name: PasswordReset
components.summary: Password reset: email → reset code + new password + confirmation.

props.name: onReset
props.type: (email: string, code: string, newPassword: string) => void | Promise<void>

a11y: labelled fields; password inputs use autocomplete="new-password"

components.name: PasswordSignIn
components.summary: Password sign-in: email + password, with an optional "Forgot password?" action.
a11y: labelled fields; password input uses autocomplete="current-password"

components.name: PublicShell
components.summary: Public/marketing shell: full-width header, centred content column, footer.
a11y: main + footer landmarks
content centred in a max-width column

components.name: Radio
components.summary: Labelled radio control (usually composed by RadioGroup).
a11y: Label wraps the input.

components.name: RadioGroup
components.summary: Grouped radio options with a shared legend, error and helper text.
a11y: fieldset + legend grouping semantics.

components.name: Section
components.summary: Labelled page section with heading, description and actions.
a11y: <section> with an <h2> heading (keeps the heading hierarchy)

components.name: Select
components.summary: Labelled dropdown with an option list and optional placeholder.
a11y: Labelled; aria-required / aria-invalid wired via useFieldA11y.

components.name: Sidebar
components.summary: Primary navigation with optional groups, collapse and a footer slot; router-agnostic.
a11y: nav[aria-label="Primary"]; collapsed items keep a title for the accessible name.

components.name: Skeleton
components.summary: Content placeholder shape; can render multiple stacked lines.
a11y: Decorative — pair with an aria-busy/loading region.

components.name: Spinner
components.summary: Indeterminate loading indicator.
a11y: role="status" + aria-live="polite"; the label is announced.

components.name: Stack
components.summary: Flex stack — the default arrangement inside a region.
a11y: layout only — DOM order is reading order

components.name: StatCard
components.summary: KPI tile for dashboards (label, value, hint, trend, icon).
a11y: values are text; trend carries a direction label as well as colour
components.snippet: <StatCard label="Open orders" value="12" trend={{ value: '+3', direction: 'up' }} />

components.name: TextArea
components.summary: Labelled multi-line text input with optional character counter.
a11y: Labelled; error/helper linked via aria-describedby.
components.snippet: <TextArea label="Spec" rows={4} maxLength={2000} showCount value={spec} onChange={…} />

components.name: ThemeToggle
components.summary: Light/dark/system theme switch (requires a ThemeProvider ancestor).
a11y: role="radiogroup" with labelled radio options (icons carry visually-hidden names).

components.name: Toast
components.summary: Single notification card (normally rendered by ToastViewport).
a11y: error/warning use role="alert"; others role="status"; the close button is labelled.

components.name: ToastViewport
components.summary: Stacked, screen-reader-announced notification region.
a11y: region[aria-label="Notifications"]; each toast announces itself.

components.name: Toggle
components.summary: Accessible switch built on a native button.
a11y: role="switch" + aria-checked; `label` supplies the accessible name.

components.name: Toolbar
components.summary: Horizontal controls bar: filters/search left, actions right.
a11y: role="toolbar"; label the controls you place inside it

components.name: Tooltip
components.summary: Hover/focus hint anchored to a trigger.
a11y: Shown on hover and focus; keep the content short and non-interactive.

components.name: TopBar
components.summary: Application header with a title, action slot and optional menu button.
a11y: header landmark; the menu trigger is a labelled IconButton.

components.name: TopNavShell
components.summary: Shell for apps with horizontal navigation (no sidebar).
a11y: main landmark for the content area

layouts.name: Asymmetrical
layouts.summary: Editorial 2/3 + 1/3 split for portfolio sites with a dominant featured column.

breakpoints.md: columns stack to a single column

a11y: single <h1> in the hero (PageHeader)
panels use titled headings for landmark-free grouping
reading order follows visual order (primary → secondary)

layouts.name: Auth-Centered
layouts.summary: Standalone centered card for sign-in and password-reset screens (no app chrome).

breakpoints.md: card fills the width minus page padding

a11y: one <h1> per screen (AuthShell)
tab list with role=tablist/tab/tabpanel and arrow-key navigation
errors announced via role=alert
layouts.notes: Auth screens are not feature-gated: any app with accounts can ship this layout.

layouts.name: Bento Grid
layouts.summary: Modular tile grid for portfolio and marketing sites — hero, highlight tiles, about and contact.
a11y: single <h1> in the hero (PageHeader)
section headings via Section (h2)
main + footer landmarks from PublicShell

layouts.name: Card-Based Dashboard
layouts.summary: Friendly, card-first dashboard for people-facing portals (patients, appointments, records).
a11y: each card exposes its own heading
status conveyed by text, not colour alone
single <h1> per screen (PageHeader)
layouts.notes: requiredFeatures is empty until the healthcare recipes land (12b.3) — the backend cross-check treats an empty list as 'no feature constraint'.

layouts.name: Strict Columnar Grid + Dashboard
layouts.summary: Dense metric strip over a rigid columnar analysis grid — finance and operations reporting.
a11y: KPI values are text (not colour-only)
trend direction carries a text label as well as colour
single <h1> per screen (PageHeader)

layouts.name: Data Table
layouts.summary: List-first, filterable record layout for dense back-office work.
a11y: DataTable caption for screen readers
toolbar controls labelled (search/filters)
single <h1> per screen (PageHeader)

layouts.name: Kanban Board
layouts.summary: Horizontally scrolling lanes for pipeline and workflow management.

breakpoints.md: lanes keep a min width and scroll
breakpoints.sm: single lane per viewport, swipe to scroll

a11y: each lane is a titled Panel (heading per lane)
board is reachable by keyboard (no drag-only interactions)
single <h1> per screen (PageHeader)

layouts.name: Split-Screen
layouts.summary: Persistent sidebar navigation with a main work area and an optional detail column.

breakpoints.md: sidebar collapses to a Drawer; detail stacks below

a11y: nav[aria-label="Primary"] for the sidebar
single <h1> per screen (PageHeader)
main landmark from AppShell

api.name: ThemeProvider
api.summary: Applies light/dark/system + per-order theme.json token overrides to <html>.

api.name: useTheme
api.summary: Read/set the theme preference (must be inside a ThemeProvider).

api.name: applyTheme
api.summary: Apply a theme.json (data-theme + CSS-variable overrides) to an element.

api.name: themeStyle
api.summary: Compute the inline style object for a theme definition.

api.name: breakpoints
api.summary: Typed pixel breakpoints mirrored from tokens.css.

api.name: mediaQueryFrom
api.summary: Build a mobile-first min-width media query string.

api.name: cssVar
api.summary: Reference a CSS custom property by name.

api.name: useFieldA11y
api.summary: Generate the label/input/error ids a field needs for aria wiring.

api.name: buildDescribedBy
api.summary: Compose an aria-describedby string from field a11y ids.
